testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel removal of a model-state parameter column: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1435:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel removal of a model-state parameter column ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user adds d0 to the model-state table and sets Copy State d0 to 2 in while leaving the other members at 1 in ✔ And The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing parameter d0 ✔ And the d0 values for Primary, Capture State, and Copy State are 1 in, 1 in, and 2 in respectively ✔ When the user selects d0 in the chosen parameters ✔ And transfers it out of the chosen parameters ✔ Then d0 is absent from the chosen parameters and the grid ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels and reopens the model-state table ✔ Then d0 is present in the chosen parameters and the grid ✔ And the d0 values for Primary, Capture State, and Copy State are 1 in, 1 in, and 2 in respectively
